statement:
The record incorrectly specifies the blue Vauxhall for this service, even though that car was sold in June and it is the grey Honda that currently has the brake warning light issue.
OK. I've booked the brake work for the grey Honda.
judge_text:
WRONG
"The record incorrectly specifies the blue Vauxhall... even though that car was sold in June" — it names the specific contradiction with the user's stated facts.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
